verdict.rationale: Daily documents a server-side REST API to create rooms, manage tokens, trigger recordings and control calls. The docs link to REST API reference pages, such as meeting-token creation. Probes confirm a published OpenAPI spec at docs.daily.co/openapi.json and an llms.txt index, so agents can discover the API programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
